parole.significato: Beneath or alongside the bed of a stream, where water percolates through interstices between the rocks leading to mixin…
parole.testo: Borrowed from Romanian hiporeic, from Ancient Greek ὑπό (hupó, “below”) + Ancient Greek ῥέος (rhéos, “flow”) + Romanian -ic. Coined by Romanian hydrobiologist Traian Orghidan in 1955.
